name: ADR01a: No. active on ART who experienced Mild AEs in the reporting quarter
description:
Number of clients active on ART who experienced an adverse drug reaction graded as mild during the reporting quarter.
The patient must have a documented ADR occurrence between :startDate and :endDate, the ADR grading must be Mild, and the patient must satisfy the active-care rule. The population is based on the dedicated ADR grading field rather than simply the presence of any medication side effect.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id AS patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.adr_date_of_occurrence >= :startDate
  AND a.adr_date_of_occurrence < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND a.adr_grading = 'Mild'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  )",

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id AS patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.adr_date_of_occurrence >= :startDate
  AND a.adr_date_of_occurrence < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND a.adr_grading = 'Mild'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  )
